title: BC Friday Tips #63 Sharing Full Screenshot
summary: Sharing full screenshots in Business Central troubleshooting and communication provides more context about company, user, and environment, making issues easier to reproduce and reducing follow-up questions.
key_points: Full screenshots provide essential context including company, user, and environment information
Complete screenshots reduce the need for back-and-forth clarification questions
Cropped or region-limited screenshots should only be used when sensitive data needs protection
More visual context leads to faster issue reproduction and resolution

quotes.text: Shows more context, like company, user, and environment.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why full screenshots help with issue diagnosis and reproduction
